title: CReal.ivt_step: one bisection step that halves the bracket without ever deciding an exact sign
statement: CReal.ivt_step is the single bisection step underlying the constructive approximate IVT (creal/ivt.rs). Given a function F, a bracket [P, Q] with P <= Q, and a fixed positive slack eps, such that F P <= eps and -eps <= F Q -- the WEAK sign invariant, not the classical exact F P <= 0 <= F Q -- the step produces a new bracket [P', Q'] nested inside [P, Q], of exactly half the width, satisfying the identical weak invariant. It never decides the sign of F at the midpoint: the case split comes from cotransitivity (CReal.lt_cotrans) applied to the FIXED, always-strict pair -eps < eps, which holds independently of F, so no undecidable comparison of F's value against zero is ever made. This is machinery, not an independent statement of IVT: it is the one step CReal.ivt_iter repeats n times and CReal.ivt_approx composes against a continuity modulus to reach a stated accuracy; on its own it makes no claim about roots existing.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.ivt_step : ((x0 : ((x0 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> ((x4 : CReal.lt CReal.zero x3) -> ((x5 : CReal.le x1 x2) -> ((x6 : CReal.le (x0 x1) x3) -> ((x7 : CReal.le (CReal.neg x3) (x0 x2)) -> Exists.{1} CReal (fun (x8 : CReal) => Exists.{1} CReal (fun (x9 : CReal) => And (CReal.le x1 x8) (And (CReal.le x8 x9) (And (CReal.le x9 x2) (And (CReal.le (x0 x8) x3) (And (CReal.le (CReal.neg x3) (x0 x9)) (CReal.Equiv (CReal.add x9 (CReal.neg x8)) (CReal.mul (CReal.add x2 (CReal.neg x1)) (CReal.ofRat (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)))))))))))))))))))

evidence.supports: CReal.ivt_step is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example theorem_dependency_inventory -- CReal.ivt_step 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^CReal\.ivt_step[[:space:]]'
evidence.notes: Two independent failure modes, so the exit status depends on the finding rather than on the run completing: theorem_dependency_inventory exits non-zero when a NAMED filter matches nothing, and grep -c exits 1 printing 0 when the anchored line is absent. Anchored with [[:space:]], never \t -- in a scripted (GNU) grep \t is a literal t. grep -c rather than grep -q, which would SIGPIPE the producer under pipefail. --release is MANDATORY: this tool builds creal/complex/cpoint, which overflow the default debug thread stack.

evidence.supports: axiom_footprint: [] -- the creal prelude's trusted surface is empty, which bounds CReal.ivt_step.
evidence.notes: --require-axiom-free exits non-zero when the named prelude's trusted surface (Axiom + Opaque + Quotient) is not empty, and errors rather than silently passing for a prelude the run never built. A declaration cannot depend on a trusted declaration the environment does not contain, so an empty creal surface bounds every declaration in it, including CReal.ivt_step. This is a whole-prelude bound, not a per-declaration measurement; the per-declaration figure is the footprint column of kernel_declaration_projection, measured 0 for this row.

provenance.source: Derived mechanically from the unfiltered emit of `cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example kernel_declaration_projection`, which prints one TSV row per declaration whose fields are (prelude, kind, display name, axiom-footprint size, direct type declarations, direct declarations, direct theorems, Kernel::render_lean(declaration.ty())). formal.statement is that last field verbatim; depends_on is the direct-theorem column intersected with this ledger's registered facts; axiom_footprint is the footprint-size column, cross-checked by the whole-prelude nat_axiom_inventory run recorded in the second evidence row. No field was hand-transcribed and no prose was authored.

notes: See creal/ivt.rs's module documentation, 'The one-step lemma, worked on paper' and 'Why not trisection', for the full derivation, including why an ordinary midpoint bisection suffices here where the textbook argument needs two interior points: an exact 0 threshold has no fixed strict pair to pivot cotransitivity on, while the slack eps supplies one (-eps < eps) unconditionally. Source: crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/creal/ivt.rs.
